content:
Headquarters:

We're looking for a highly experienced Mechanical Engineer who can hit the ground running on a fast-paced, short-term remote engagement. This is a hands-on design role for someone who thrives under tight timelines and can move from onboarding to meaningful output within days, not weeks. You'll be working deep in Siemens NX on plastics-focused design challenges, contributing directly to parts that are headed toward injection molding production.

What You'll Do

  • Deliver mechanical design work in Siemens NX with a focus on plastic components for injection molding
  • Design and refine TPU overmolded parts
  • Manage heat insert placement and integration into plastic housings
  • Apply functional dimensioning and geometric tolerancing to ensure manufacturability
  • Perform tolerance stack-up analysis to validate fit and function across assemblies
  • Support IP-rated enclosure design and button/user interface component design

What You Bring

  • Strong, hands-on experience with Siemens NX
  • Proven track record designing injection-molded plastic parts
  • Experience with TPU overmolding
  • Practical knowledge of heat insert management and integration
  • Solid grasp of functional dimensioning and tolerance stack-up analysis
  • Experience with IP-rated design
  • Experience with button/user interface design
  • Ability to start immediately and ramp up quickly with minimal onboarding time

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-mechanical-engineer
